## Architectural style
- Dependency direction: Source-code dependencies point only inward. Nothing in an inner circle knows anything about an outer circle. (Martin, *Clean Architecture* (2017), ch. 22 "The Clean Architecture", the Dependency Rule)
- Domain purity: Entities and use cases do not depend on frameworks, databases or the UI. (Martin 2017, ch. 22; ch. 32 "Frameworks are details")
- Repository / gateway placement: The data-access interface is owned by the inner layer, and the implementation lives in the outer layer (dependency inversion across the boundary). (Martin 2017, ch. 22 (interface adapters); ch. 11 (DIP))
- Acyclic dependencies: The component dependency graph has no cycles. (Martin 2017, ch. 14 "Component Coupling", ADP)
